scheme_name: Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu Widow Remarriage Assistance Scheme-II
other_conditions: Applicant must be at least 20 years old
Applicant must have a degree from regular colleges, distance education, or government‑recognized open university
Applicant must have a diploma recognized by the Directorate of Technical Education, Government of Tamil Nadu
Bridegroom should be less than 40 years old
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 plus a sovereign (8 gm) 22‑carat gold coin, disbursed as ₹15,000 via Electronic Clearing Service and ₹10,000 as a National Savings Certificate.
